Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that matches what we covered. Confirming our usual procurement flow: legal review -> security review (infosec) -> finance -> PO issuance. Typical calendar for a new vendor is about 3–6 weeks depending on queue and whether we need any offline risk exceptions. For this scope I’d estimate ~4 weeks if there aren’t major comments.

Pilot payment: Finance is usually open to card for low-dollar pilot pilots, but procurement prefers a PO when legal is involved. If we can keep the pilot contract value under our low-risk threshold ($20k), card could be an option to get started immediately.

Procurement contact to start the intake is Mike Chen (procurement@acmecloud.com) — I’ve cc'd them. Please send SOW and standard T&Cs; Mike will flag what needs to go into the MSA/PO.

Marketplace: we do have an internal partner marketplace — we’re open to discussing that after the pilot validates performance. It can help accelerate procurement in later stages.

Jordan
Director, Platform Partnerships
AcmeCloud
jordan.ellis@acmecloud.com
